title: 第009章 他牵着她继妹的手
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

手帕是绅士的必备配饰，谢亭渝不会差这一块。

以他的性格和习惯，给她之后理应无所谓地丢掉，为什么还要在程昱面前向她讨要？

重逢以来舒楹一直看不懂他，手帕一事又给了她更复杂的感受。

不过谢亭渝不屑骗人，许栀意确实来过医院。

王思嘉把绵绵带得很好，她回来的时候绵绵正在玩许栀意送的jellycat玩偶。

绵绵很喜欢这个胖乎乎的大茄子，看到她才恋恋不舍地放下玩偶跟她要抱抱。

“绵绵今天难不难受啊？”舒楹低头询问她的情况。

绵绵嘿嘿直笑，一副没心没肺的样子。

王思嘉笑着说道：“绵绵比我带的其他孩子省心很多，你不在她打针那会哭了两声，其他时候都很乖。”

“我工作忙，平时在家待得少，只有晚上能陪着她睡觉。”舒楹提起育儿一事就止不住地愧疚。

她当初要孩子的目的不单纯，向来苛待她的命运在这方面待她不薄，给她送来了全世界最好的绵绵。

这一点她很感恩。

“看绵绵对你的依赖程度，你已经在最大限度上对她好了，”王思嘉在一旁宽慰道。

舒楹道了声谢，送她离开了病房。

sy：【谢谢你送的jellycat，绵绵很喜欢】

回来后她给许栀意发了消息，得到后者的一条语音，“姐，不用这么客气。我看绵绵上次很喜欢我房间里的玩偶，就让阿渝托人从港岛带了，今天刚送到。”

舒楹没料到连这种小事也跟谢亭渝有关。她其实有点烦了，但还是在心里提醒自己，热恋中的女人三句不离另一半很正常。

她靠到沙发上，随便找了个表情包敷衍了过去。

大概是见到谢亭渝的次数太多了，她晚上做梦梦见了他。

地点是在她以前居住的公寓里，谢亭渝将她压在落地窗前，掐着她的脖子质问她为什么偷偷生下了他的孩子。

“……我没有，孩子不是你的。”

他嫌她说话难听，拿那个墨绿色的手帕堵住了她的嘴唇。

作为惩罚，他恶劣地吻过她身体各个角落，激得她汗毛冒起，脚趾蜷缩。

Page (1/3)

A handkerchief is a must-have accessory for a gentleman, and Xie Tingyu will never miss this one.

With his character and habits, he should just throw it away after giving it to her, so why should he ask her for it in front of Cheng Yu?

Shu Ying has been unable to understand him since the reunion, and the handkerchief incident gave her more complicated feelings.

However, Xie Tingyu didn't bother to lie, and Xu Zhiyi had indeed been to the hospital.

Wang Sijia took Mianmian very well. When she came back, Mianmian was playing with the jellycat doll given by Xu Zhiyi.

Mianmian liked this chubby big eggplant very much. When she saw her, she reluctantly put down the doll and wanted to hug her.

"Is Mianmian feeling uncomfortable today?" Shu Ying lowered his head and asked about her situation.

Mianmian laughed heartlessly.

Wang Sijia said with a smile: "Mianmian is much more worry-free than the other children I brought up. She would cry twice when you were not there for the injection, but she is very well-behaved at other times."

"I'm busy with work and don't spend much time at home. I can only sleep with her at night." Shu Ying couldn't help but feel guilty when she mentioned parenting.

Her original purpose for having a child was not simple. Fate, which had always been harsh on her, treated her well in this regard and gave her the best love in the world.

For this she was grateful.

"Looking at how much Mianmian relies on you, you have treated her as well as possible," Wang Sijia said with relief.

Shu Ying thanked her and sent her out of the ward.

sy: [Thank you for the jellycat, Mianmian likes it very much]

After she came back, she sent a message to Xu Zhiyi and received a voice message from the latter, "Sister, you don't have to be so polite. I saw that Mianmian liked the doll in my room very much last time, so I asked Ayu to ask someone to bring it from Hong Kong Island. It was just delivered today."

Shu Ying did not expect that even such a trivial matter would be related to Xie Tingyu.She was actually a little annoyed, but she still reminded herself in her mind that it was normal for a woman in love to never leave her partner.

She leaned on the sofa and found an emoticon to deal with it.

Probably because she saw Xie Tingyu too many times, she dreamed of him at night.

The location was in the apartment where she used to live. Xie Tingyu pressed her in front of the floor-to-ceiling window, pinched her neck and asked her why she secretly gave birth to his child.

"...I didn't. The child is not yours."

He thought her words were unpleasant, so he blocked her lips with the dark green handkerchief.

As punishment, he kissed every corner of her body harshly, making her hair stand on end and her toes curling up.
